calculation: DFT-PBE DOS, collinear spin polarization, norm-conserving pseudopotential
cubic_lattice_parameter_note: The cubic cell edge, celldm(1) = 6.625 bohr in the decks; the material file states the rhombohedral primitive edge, 2.478974 angstrom.

scf_ground_state.qe_source: examples/total_energy--metal--magnetic--nickel/reference/nc/reference.json -- the same cell, pseudopotential, cutoffs, k-grid, smearing and starting magnetization this example's SCF block uses.
scf_ground_state.q3_source: Q3 built at 0467b8e, running ../nc.yml with control.calculation switched to self_consistent_field. The SCF block here is identical to the one in band_structure--metal--magnetic--nickel/nc.yml, so both examples share this ground state.

expected_features.spin_resolved: majority and minority DOS differ -- the integral of their difference to E_F is the ~0.62 Bohr magneton moment above
expected_features.minority_d_band: peak straddling E_F, leaving the d holes that carry the moment
expected_features.note: Ni is the magnetic counterpart of the Cu DOS example: the same FCC cell and d-band complex, exchange-split into two channels instead of one.
